desc.en: Load and manage Agent Skills on this computer in one place.
desc.zh: 统一加载和管理本机 Agent Skills。

search.placeholder.en: Search skill names, descriptions or notes
search.placeholder.zh: 搜索技能名称、描述或备注

empty.source.en: This source does not exist or has no skills yet.
empty.source.zh: 该来源目录不存在或暂时没有技能。

category.note.en: Categories stay in this source and do not move files.
category.note.zh: 分类只记在这个来源里，不移动文件。

category.empty.en: No skills yet. Use More on a skill to place it here.
category.empty.zh: 还没有技能。从条目的「更多」归入。

category.created.en: Added category “{name}”. No directory was created.
category.created.zh: 已添加分类「{name}」。文件没有新建目录。

category.renamed.en: Renamed. Skill file names are unchanged.
category.renamed.zh: 已重命名。技能文件名没有变化。

category.deleted.en: Deleted category “{name}”. Skills returned to Uncategorized and were not trashed.
category.deleted.zh: 已删除分类「{name}」。技能回到未分类，没有进回收站。

category.assigned.en: Moved {name} to “{category}”. The file was not moved.
category.assigned.zh: 已将 {name} 归入「{category}」。文件没有移动。

category.dragTip.en: Drag to reorder or move to another category
category.dragTip.zh: 拖拽调整顺序或移动到其他分类

category.moved.en: Updated the category or order for {name}.
category.moved.zh: 已调整技能 {name} 的分类或顺序。

confirm.category.desc.en: “{name}” will be removed. Its skills return to Uncategorized. Files are not moved.
confirm.category.desc.zh: 「{name}」会消失，里面的技能回到未分类。文件不会移动。

error.category.duplicate.en: A category with this name already exists: {name}

error.category.name.en: Category name is required and must be at most 24 characters
error.category.name.zh: 分类名称不能为空，且不能超过 24 个字符

error.category.target.en: The target skill is not in the destination category
error.category.target.zh: 排序目标不属于目标分类

note.placeholder.en: Record what this skill does and when to use it…
note.placeholder.zh: 记录这个技能是干嘛的、什么时候用…

note.help.en: Saved in the plugin display layer without modifying SKILL.md. Clear to revert to original description.
note.help.zh: 保存在插件内部显示层，不修改原 SKILL.md。清空可还原为原简介。

error.note.tooLarge.en: Custom note is too long (maximum {max} characters)
error.note.tooLarge.zh: 自定义简介过长（最多 {max} 个字符）

create.description.placeholder.en: One sentence describing when to use it
create.description.placeholder.zh: 一句话说明什么时候使用

create.body.placeholder.en: Write the instructions, steps, and boundaries…
create.body.placeholder.zh: 写下技能要遵循的指令、步骤和边界…

create.chat.note.en: Created skills are not linked to repository updates, and no source file is modified.
create.chat.note.zh: 创建的技能不会挂仓库更新，也不会修改原文件。

upload.drop.copy.en: Supports .zip, a skill folder, or one SKILL.md
upload.drop.copy.zh: 支持 .zip、技能文件夹或单个 SKILL.md

upload.requirement.skill.en: Archives and folders must contain SKILL.md
upload.requirement.skill.zh: 压缩包或文件夹需包含 SKILL.md

upload.requirement.frontmatter.en: SKILL.md must include a YAML name and description
upload.requirement.frontmatter.zh: SKILL.md 需包含 YAML 格式的技能名称和描述

upload.requirement.copy.en: Import copies all content and never modifies the source
upload.requirement.copy.zh: 导入时复制完整内容，不修改原始来源

select.file.invalid.en: Choose a .zip archive or one SKILL.md.
select.file.invalid.zh: 请选择 .zip 或单个 SKILL.md。

select.folder.invalid.en: No SKILL.md was found in the selected folder.
select.folder.invalid.zh: 所选文件夹中没有找到 SKILL.md。

error.browse.absolute.zh: 目录路径必须是绝对路径：{path}

confirm.trash.desc.en: “{name}” will move out of its current skill source and can be restored to the same location later.
confirm.trash.desc.zh: “{name}”将从当前技能来源移入回收站，之后可以恢复到原位置。

confirm.delete.desc.en: “{name}” will be permanently deleted from trash and cannot be recovered.
confirm.delete.desc.zh: “{name}”将从回收站永久删除，无法恢复。

result.importPartial.zh: 已导入：{imported}；已跳过同名技能：{skipped}

result.importSkipped.en: No skills were imported; existing skills were skipped: {names}
result.importSkipped.zh: 未导入任何技能；已跳过同名技能：{names}

warning.scan.truncated.en: Some skills were not shown because the directory is too large or deeply nested: {path}
warning.scan.truncated.zh: 技能目录较大或嵌套过深，部分技能未显示：{path}

warning.state.invalid.en: The manager state file could not be read; all skills are disabled and state writes are blocked until it is repaired: {path}
warning.state.invalid.zh: 技能管理器状态文件不可读；所有技能已安全停用，修复文件前不会覆盖状态：{path}

warning.backupUncleaned.en: Old version backup was not cleaned up: {path} ({error})

warning.project.missing.en: The workspace directory does not exist and may have been moved or deleted: {path}
warning.project.missing.zh: 工作区目录不存在，可能已被移动或删除：{path}

warning.project.unreadable.en: No permission to read the workspace directory: {path} ({code})
warning.project.unreadable.zh: 无权限读取工作区目录：{path}（{code}）

warning.project.unavailable.en: The active workspace could not be read from the host, so its project skills are hidden: {path}
warning.project.unavailable.zh: 无法从宿主读取活动工作区，项目技能未显示：{path}

error.workspace.unregistered.zh: 请选择已登记的工作区。

error.root.unsafe.en: The project skill directory is unsafe, so the write was refused: {path}
error.root.unsafe.zh: 项目技能目录不安全，拒绝写入：{path}

error.skill.linked.en: This directory link cannot be deleted or overwritten: {path}
error.skill.linked.zh: 目录链接不能删除或覆盖：{path}

error.skill.noFrontmatter.zh: 技能缺少完整 frontmatter，无法{action}: {name}

error.source.symlink.en: Skill sources containing symbolic links are not supported: {path}
error.source.symlink.zh: 不支持包含符号链接的 skill 来源: {path}

error.source.unrecognized.zh: 无法识别的 skill 来源: {path}

error.source.tooDeep.en: Skill source directory depth exceeds {depth} levels: {path}
error.source.tooDeep.zh: skill 来源目录层级超过 {depth} 层: {path}

error.import.overlap.en: Import source cannot be the same as, contain, or be inside the DSH skills directory
error.import.overlap.zh: 导入来源不能与 DSH 技能目录相同、包含或位于其中

error.import.emptySource.en: No skill entries found in the directory: {path}
error.import.emptySource.zh: 目录下未找到任何 skill 条目: {path}

error.import.invalidName.en: Cannot generate a valid kebab-case name (original: {name})
error.import.invalidName.zh: 无法生成合法 kebab-case 名称（原始名: {name}）

error.import.duplicateName.en: Batch source contains duplicate skill names: {name}
error.import.duplicateName.zh: 批量来源中存在多个同名技能: {name}

error.import.rollbackFailed.en: Overwrite import rollback failed; backups kept at: {path} ({error})
error.import.rollbackFailed.zh: 覆盖导入回滚失败，备份保留在: {path}（{error}）

error.upload.path.zh: 上传内容包含非法路径：{path}

error.upload.tooMany.zh: 上传文件过多，最多 {limit} 个

error.upload.tooLarge.en: Upload is too large; limit {limit} bytes
error.upload.tooLarge.zh: 上传内容过大，限制为 {limit} 字节

error.upload.archiveTooLarge.en: ZIP archive is too large; limit {limit} bytes
error.upload.archiveTooLarge.zh: ZIP 压缩包过大，限制为 {limit} 字节

error.upload.duplicate.zh: 上传内容包含重复路径：{path}

error.upload.zipInvalid.en: ZIP archive could not be extracted

error.trash.conflict.en: Cannot restore because a skill with the same name exists: {name}
error.trash.conflict.zh: 无法恢复，同名技能已存在: {name}

error.trash.projectUnavailable.en: The original project is not an active workspace, so this skill cannot be restored: {path}
error.trash.projectUnavailable.zh: 原项目当前不在活动工作区中，无法恢复：{path}

error.trash.rollbackFailed.en: Move-to-trash rollback failed; unrecovered content was kept at: {path} ({error})
error.trash.rollbackFailed.zh: 移入回收站回滚失败，未恢复内容保留在: {path}（{error}）

error.state.invalid.en: The manager state file could not be read, so overwriting it was refused: {path}
error.state.invalid.zh: 技能管理器状态文件不可读，已拒绝覆盖：{path}

error.create.conflict.en: A skill with the same name already exists: {name}

error.proto.forbidden.zh: 禁止的修改请求（缺少客户端标记）

error.proto.nonJson.zh: 服务端返回非 JSON 响应（HTTP {status}）

error.catalog.upstream.en: The catalog service is temporarily unavailable.

error.catalog.response.en: The catalog response is invalid or too large.
error.catalog.response.zh: 目录返回的数据无效或过大。

error.catalog.identity.en: The catalog skill identifier is invalid.

diagnostic.name.invalid.en: Skill name format is not supported by host (lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens only), cannot be enabled. To invoke it, specify an English name in the SKILL.md frontmatter (directory name can remain unchanged): {name}
diagnostic.name.invalid.zh: 宿主不支持此技能名称格式（仅支持英文小写字母、数字与连字符），无法启用。如需调用，请在 SKILL.md frontmatter 中指定英文 name（目录名可保留中文）：{name}

diagnostic.shadowed.zh: 被更高优先级来源 {root} 覆盖

scope.userHint.en: Available across projects. Toggles only affect invocation in DSH.
scope.userHint.zh: 跨项目可用。启停仅影响 DSH 中的调用。

scope.projectHint.en: View project skills by workspace. Toggles do not modify other agents’ source files.
scope.projectHint.zh: 按工作区查看项目技能。启停不修改其他 Agent 的源文件。

project.empty.en: No registered workspaces yet. Add one in the sidebar first.
project.empty.zh: 还没有已登记的工作区。请先在侧栏添加工作区。

project.noSkills.en: Registered workspaces do not have skills yet.
project.noSkills.zh: 已登记的工作区里还没有技能。

workspace.noSkills.en: No skills in this workspace yet.
workspace.noSkills.zh: 这个工作区还没有技能。

status.shadowedBy.en: Overridden by the same skill in {source}
status.shadowedBy.zh: 被 {source} 中的同名技能覆盖

status.fallback.user.zh: 当前使用全局 {source} 副本。

status.fallback.project.zh: 当前使用项目 {source} 副本。

source.selectHint.en: Select a source to view its directory or turn the whole source off. Turning a source off only affects invocation in DSH and does not change files.
source.selectHint.zh: 先选择一个来源，才能查看目录或关闭整个来源。关闭来源只影响 DSH 调用，不改文件。

category.batchAssigned.en: Added {count} skills to “{category}”. Files were not moved.
category.batchAssigned.zh: 已将 {count} 个技能添加到“{category}”。文件未移动。

group.hint.en: Inside each source directory, verifiable records add a repository → directory hierarchy: install record → directory lock file → skill metadata; other sources are marked Unknown source. Directory names are not guessed.
group.hint.zh: 在来源目录下按可核查的记录再分「仓库 → 仓库内目录」：安装记录 → 目录锁文件 → 技能元数据；没有记录的标为「来源未知」，不按目录名称猜测。

group.provenanceCount.zh: {repos} 个来源仓库 · {unknown} 个技能来源未知

group.noRepo.en: No verifiable repository record; grouped by source directory.
group.noRepo.zh: 没有可核查的仓库记录，按来源目录归类。

rootPath.desc.en: Only changes where this plugin reads skills. No files are moved. External sources stay read-only; to change the agent's own folder, update that agent's configuration.
rootPath.desc.zh: 只改本插件读取的位置，不移动任何文件。外部来源仍然只读；要让该 Agent 自己换目录，请改它自己的配置。

rootPath.label.en: Skills folder (the parent of SKILL.md files)
rootPath.label.zh: 技能目录（含 SKILL.md 的上一级）

rootPath.pickUnavailable.en: No directory picker is available here; type the path instead.
rootPath.pickUnavailable.zh: 当前环境没有可用的目录选择器，请直接输入路径。

error.rootPath.unsupported.en: This skill source does not support changing its folder: {root}
error.rootPath.unsupported.zh: 该技能来源不支持修改目录：{root}

error.rootPath.absolute.en: The skills folder must be an absolute path: {path}
error.rootPath.absolute.zh: 技能目录必须是绝对路径：{path}

error.rootPath.tooLong.en: The skills folder path is too long: {path}

error.rootPath.notFound.en: The skills folder does not exist: {path}

error.rootPath.notDirectory.en: The skills folder is not a directory: {path}

error.rootPath.overlap.en: The skills folder must not overlap another skill source: {path}
error.rootPath.overlap.zh: 技能目录不能与其它技能来源重叠：{path}

error.rootPath.reserved.en: The skills folder must not overlap the manager's state folder: {path}
error.rootPath.reserved.zh: 技能目录不能与技能管理器的状态目录重叠：{path}

warning.rootPath.invalid.en: Ignored an invalid skills folder setting: {path}
warning.rootPath.invalid.zh: 技能目录配置项无效，已忽略：{path}

warning.rootPath.corrupt.en: The skills folder settings could not be read; defaults are in use: {path}
warning.rootPath.corrupt.zh: 技能目录配置不可读，已使用默认目录：{path}

warning.rootPath.missing.en: The custom skills folder does not exist: {path}
warning.rootPath.missing.zh: 自定义技能目录不存在：{path}

customSource.desc.en: Register skill folders for agents that are not in the built-in list. Read-only: nothing is moved or modified. You can also point at a product folder and scan for the skills folders inside it.
customSource.desc.zh: 登记清单外的 Agent 技能目录：只读取，不移动也不改动第三方文件。也可以填产品总目录点「扫描子目录」，自动找出各子目录下的 skills。

customSource.path.en: Skills folder (the parent of SKILL.md files)
customSource.path.zh: 技能目录（含 SKILL.md 的上一级）

customSource.label.en: Display name (empty uses the folder name)
customSource.label.zh: 显示名（留空则用目录名）

customSource.scanResult.zh: 在 {path} 下找到 {count} 个技能目录

customSource.added.zh: 已添加 {count} 个自定义来源。

customSource.removed.zh: 已移除该自定义来源的登记。

error.customSource.limit.zh: 自定义来源数量已达上限：{limit}

error.customSource.label.en: A custom source needs a display name: {path}
error.customSource.label.zh: 自定义来源必须有显示名：{path}

error.customSource.empty.zh: 没有要添加的技能来源

repo.catalog.reassociate.en: Choose destination and reinstall to reassociate
repo.catalog.reassociate.zh: 选择位置并重关联安装

repo.catalog.unknownHint.en: Some legacy catalog installs have unknown locations. Find the skill and choose a destination to reinstall and reassociate.
repo.catalog.unknownHint.zh: 有旧目录安装记录位置未知；找到对应技能后可选择位置重关联安装。

repo.catalog.installRefreshWarning.en: Installed and enabled, but the list could not refresh. Reopen Discover Skills; do not install again.
repo.catalog.installRefreshWarning.zh: 技能已安装并启用，但列表刷新失败。请重新打开发现页；不要重复安装。

repo.catalog.uninstallRefreshWarning.en: Moved to trash, but the list could not refresh. Refresh the skill list or reopen Settings; do not uninstall again.
repo.catalog.uninstallRefreshWarning.zh: 技能已移入回收站，但列表刷新失败。请刷新技能列表或重新打开设置页；不要重复卸载。

repo.destinationUnavailable.en: The original project is unregistered or unavailable. Re-register it in the sidebar and refresh to manage this copy.
repo.destinationUnavailable.zh: 原项目未登记或目录不可用，无法管理此副本。请在侧栏重新登记原项目后刷新。

repo.partialRefreshFailed.en: Failed to check updates for some repositories ({names}); others completed.
repo.partialRefreshFailed.zh: 部分仓库检查更新失败（{names}），其余已完成

repo.overwrite.en: Back up local edits and replace

repo.modified.en: Local edits detected. Replacement overwrites current files and keeps a complete backup for restoration.
repo.modified.zh: 检测到本地修改。替换会覆盖当前文件，原文件将完整备份，可恢复。

repo.updateProgress.en: Verifying, backing up and replacing files. Please wait…
repo.updateProgress.zh: 正在校验、备份并替换，请稍候…

repo.updateSuccess.zh: 更新完成，已保留上一版备份。

error.repo.modified.en: Local edits detected. Review and confirm replacement with a backup.
error.repo.modified.zh: 存在本地修改，请预览并确认备份后替换。

repo.catalog.searchEmpty.en: No matching ClawHub skills were found.
repo.catalog.searchEmpty.zh: 没有找到匹配的 ClawHub 技能。

repo.catalog.skillshEmpty.en: No matching skills.sh skills were found.
repo.catalog.skillshEmpty.zh: 没有找到匹配的 skills.sh 技能。

repo.subsource.catalogNote.en: ClawHub download ranking · Up to 100; sort only displayed items
repo.subsource.catalogNote.zh: ClawHub 下载量榜 · 最多 100 条，仅对当前显示条目排序

repo.catalog.empty.en: No matching skills were returned by ClawHub.
repo.catalog.empty.zh: ClawHub 当前没有匹配的技能。

repo.catalog.loading.zh: 正在加载 ClawHub 榜单…

repo.catalog.loadError.en: Failed to load the ClawHub ranking. Check your connection and retry.
repo.catalog.loadError.zh: ClawHub 榜单加载失败。请检查网络后重试。

repo.hint.en: Discover skills from subscribed Git repositories or community registries, and install them to user DSH skills or Shared Agent, or a registered project's .dsh/skills.
repo.hint.zh: 从已订阅的 Git 仓库或第三方目录发现技能，安装到用户目录的 DSH skills 或 Shared Agent，或已登记项目的 .dsh/skills。

repo.footer.en: Refresh checks repositories and skill updates without replacing local files. Historical backups are not cleaned automatically and use additional disk space.
repo.footer.zh: 刷新会检查仓库与技能更新，不会自动替换本地文件。历史备份不会自动清理，占用空间会随更新增加。

repo.installProgress.en: Reading and verifying skill files. Please wait…
repo.installProgress.zh: 正在读取并校验技能文件，请稍候…

repo.installSuccess.en: Installed and enabled. Invoke it from the slash menu.
repo.installSuccess.zh: 安装成功并已启用，可在对话中用斜杠调用。

repo.rootDshHint.en: For DSH only. The path uses your current DSH_HOME.
repo.rootDshHint.zh: 仅供 DSH 使用，路径以当前 DSH_HOME 为准。

repo.rootExternalHint.en: Other agents using this directory can read this skill too.
repo.rootExternalHint.zh: 使用该目录的其他 Agent 也能读取此技能。

repo.installLocationsHint.en: User directories offer DSH skills or Shared Agent; registered projects write only to .dsh/skills. The chooser shows actual paths. Missing directories are created after confirmation. Unsafe paths cannot be selected.
repo.installLocationsHint.zh: 用户目录可选 DSH skills 或 Shared Agent；已登记项目仅写入 .dsh/skills。选择器显示实际路径。缺少的目录会在确认安装后创建。不安全的路径不可选。

repo.uninstallHint.en: Move only this repository’s tracked installed copy, including local edits, to Trash. You can restore it from Trash later.
repo.uninstallHint.zh: 仅将此仓库已跟踪的安装副本移至回收站，包括本地修改。之后可在回收站恢复。

repo.uninstallExternalWarning.en: Uninstalling this skill also affects other agents that use the selected directory.
repo.uninstallExternalWarning.zh: 卸载该技能也会影响使用所选目录的其他 Agent。

repo.uninstallProgress.en: Moving the installed skill to Trash. Please wait…
repo.uninstallProgress.zh: 正在将已安装的技能移至回收站，请稍候…

repo.uninstallSuccess.en: Skill moved to Trash. You can restore it from Trash.
repo.uninstallSuccess.zh: 技能已移至回收站，可在回收站恢复。

repo.empty.en: No repositories yet. Add a Git repository to get started.
repo.empty.zh: 还没有技能仓库，添加一个 Git 仓库开始。

repo.noSkills.en: No matching skills. Refresh the repository or adjust your filters.
repo.noSkills.zh: 没有匹配的技能。可刷新仓库或调整筛选。

repo.urlPlaceholder.en: owner/repo or full Git repository URL
repo.urlPlaceholder.zh: owner/repo 或完整 Git 地址

repo.defaultBranch.en: Leave empty for the default branch

repo.directoryHint.en: For example: skills. Leave empty to scan the repository.
repo.directoryHint.zh: 例如 skills，留空扫描整个仓库

repo.removeHint.en: This removes the subscription only. Installed skills are kept.
repo.removeHint.zh: 仅移除仓库订阅，已安装的技能会保留。

repo.installHint.en: Skills may include scripts. Read the instructions and trust the source before installing. Resources are copied; scripts are not executed.
repo.installHint.zh: 技能可能包含脚本，请先查看说明并确认信任来源。安装会保留资源文件，不会执行脚本。

error.repo.tooLarge.en: Repository exceeds size limit. Choose a smaller repository.
error.repo.tooLarge.zh: 仓库超过大小限制，请选择较小的技能仓库。

error.repo.transientTooLarge.en: Repository transient download size exceeds limit (including Git objects). Choose a smaller repository.
error.repo.transientTooLarge.zh: 仓库临时下载体积过大（包含 Git 历史对象），请选择较小的技能仓库。

error.repo.disk.en: Not enough free disk space to check out this repository. Free up space and retry.
error.repo.disk.zh: 磁盘剩余空间不足，无法检出该仓库。请清理磁盘空间后重试。

error.repo.noGit.en: Git command-line tool not found. Please install Git and retry.
error.repo.noGit.zh: 未检测到 Git 命令行工具，请先安装 Git 后重试。

error.repo.installState.en: Skill files were preserved but source tracking could not be saved. Restore disk write access and reopen Repositories to verify files and recover the record.
error.repo.installState.zh: 技能文件已保留，但来源状态未确认。请恢复磁盘写入后重新打开仓库页，系统会校验文件并恢复记录。

error.repo.capacity.en: Source tracking exceeds 16 MiB. Remove unneeded Trash records or legacy identities first. Active installation copies are kept.
error.repo.capacity.zh: 安装来源状态超过 16 MiB。请先清理不需要的回收记录或旧身份，仍有效的安装副本会保留。

error.repo.invalid.en: Invalid repository URL, path or contents. Check the input and repository size.
error.repo.invalid.zh: 仓库地址、路径或内容无效，请检查输入及仓库大小。

error.repo.network.en: Repository request failed. Check your connection or retry later. The previous catalog was kept.
error.repo.network.zh: 仓库访问失败，请检查网络或稍后重试。上次列表已保留。

error.repo.state.en: Repository state is corrupt or unreadable. Preserve the file and repair it before retrying.
error.repo.state.zh: 仓库状态文件损坏或无法读取，请保留文件并修复后重试。

error.repo.conflict.en: A skill with this name exists or installation failed. Local files were not overwritten.
error.repo.conflict.zh: 同名技能已存在或安装失败，本地文件未被覆盖。

error.repo.enableState.en: The copied skill was removed because its enabled state could not be saved. Restore disk write access and install again.
error.repo.enableState.zh: 技能文件已撤销，但启用状态无法写入。请恢复磁盘写入后重试安装。

dest.pickFirst.en: Select a registered workspace first. No directory is created before you confirm.
dest.pickFirst.zh: 先选择一个已登记工作区。确认前不会创建目录。

dest.empty.en: No registered workspaces yet. Add one in the sidebar, then come back.
dest.empty.zh: 还没有已登记的工作区。请先在侧栏添加，再回到这里选择。

dest.location.agentsOff.zh: 工作区只支持 DSH skills。

dest.projectNote.en: This is written into the project and may be committed to its repository.
dest.projectNote.zh: 会写进这个项目，可能被提交到仓库。

dest.createdInWorkspace.en: Created in the selected workspace. It appears in sessions of that workspace.
dest.createdInWorkspace.zh: 已创建在所选工作区。要在该工作区的会话里才会看到。

entry.location.desc.en: Choose where to show the entry (at least one is retained to avoid losing access).
entry.location.desc.zh: 选择技能管理入口的展示位置（至少保留一处，防止无法打开面板）。

sidebar.entry.desc.en: Show Skills below Plugins in the sidebar. The Settings entry stays either way.
sidebar.entry.desc.zh: 在侧栏「插件」下方显示技能。设置里的入口不变。

update.entry.desc.en: Allow checking and installing new versions online. Hides the update entry when disabled.
update.entry.desc.zh: 允许检查并在线安装技能管理器的新版本。关闭后隐藏更新入口。

update.entry.locked.en: Online updates are disabled by the host configuration.
update.entry.locked.zh: 在线更新已被宿主配置禁用

Load and safely manage local Agent Skill.zh: 统一加载并安全管理本机 Agent Skills。
